rv.q: Being a comedy sketch stretched out to feature length, An Act of God inevitably has its longueurs.
Even at just 90 minutes, “An Act of God” (directed by the prolific Joe Mantello) is long-winded and full of unoriginal jabs at easy targets, but it is cute and occasionally witty.
Overall the play is laugh out loud funny; Parsons is brilliant in his role; and it is not surprising that there have already been repeat audience members because it is one to see over again!

cn.t: Critics find this comedic monologue moderately amusing but underwhelming, with Hayes delivering an authoritative and funny performance as God that doesn't fully elevate Javerbaum's uneven material.
